victim.parameterization: 13 convolutional layers, batch normalization after every convolution, five max-pools, 512-D global-average-pooled feature, ten-way linear head
victim.augmentation: reflect-pad-4 random crop plus random horizontal flip

attack.selection_population: non-target rows in the fixed 45000-row training split
attack.resize: torchvision Resize((32,32)) with bilinear interpolation and antialiasing

development_gate.endpoint_selection: choose the earliest prelisted evaluation epoch meeting both gates; otherwise revise only on seed 4400

claim_boundary: This run may select a victim training horizon only. It cannot support detector or SRAC claims and cannot be called prospective confirmation.
